paite: Aigupta gam akipan a hongpawt uh kum nih kum, kha nihna, ni khat niin Sinai gamdai ah kihoupihna puanin ah TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
english: Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

paite: Israel saunte a omkhawm tengteng, a chi chiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin pasal tengteng sim vekin;
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one;

paite: Kum sawmnih akipan tunglam Israel laka galkap thei chiang peuhmah nang leh Aronin a pawlpawlin na sim vek ding uhi.
english: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall number them by their divisions.

paite: Huan, na kiangah nam chih laka khat, inkuana lupen jel a om ding uh ahi.
english: With you there shall be a man of every tribe; everyone head of his fathers’ house.

paite: Huan, hiaite na kianga om dingte min ahi: Reuben nama Sedeur tapa Elizur,
english: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

paite: Simeon nama Zurisaddai tapa Selumiel.
english: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

paite: Juda nama Amminadab tapa Nahson.
english: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

paite: Isakar nama Zuar tapa Nethanel.
english: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

paite: Zebulun nama Helon tapa Eliab.
english: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

paite: Joseph tate, Ephraim nama Ammihud tapa Elisama: Manasseh nama Pedahzur tapa Gamaliel.
english: Of the children of Joseph: Of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud. Of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

paite: Benjamin nama Gideoni tapa Abidan.
english: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

paite: Dan nama Ammisaddai tapa Ahiezer.
english: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

paite: Aser nama Okran tapa Pagiel.
english: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

paite: Gad nama Deuel tapa Eliasaph.
english: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

paite: Naphtali nama Enan tapa Ahira.
english: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

paite: Hiaite mipite tel, a pi leh pute uh nama lupen Israel inkuana lupente ahi uh, chiin.
english: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

paite: Huchiin Mosi leh Aronin huai mi a min uh a lohte uh a pi ua:
english: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

paite: Mipi tengteng kha nihna, ni khat niin a sam khawm vek ua; a chichiin, a inkuan kuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam teng a pipute uh min a taklang uhi.
english: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

paite: TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak bangin Sinai gamdai ah a simta hi.
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: Israel tapa upapen, Reuben tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin pasal kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
english: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Reuben nam, a simte uh sing li leh sang guk leh za nga ahi uhi.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

paite: Simeon tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin pasal kum sawmnih akipan tunglam galkap thei teng a sim ua;
english: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were numbered of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Simeon nam, a simte uh sing nga leh sang kua leh za thum ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

paite: Gad tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin pasal kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
english: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Gad nama, a simte uh sing li leh sang nga leh za guk leh sawmnga ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

paite: Juda tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thie teng a sim ua;
english: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Juda nama, a simte uh sing sagih leh sang li leh za guk ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, were sixty-four thousand six hundred.

paite: Isakar tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizom dan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
english: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Isakar nama, a simte uh sing nga leh sang li leh za li ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

paite: Zebulun tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizom dan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
english: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Zebulun nama, a simte uh sing nga leh sang sagih leh za li ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

paite: Joseph tate laka Ephraim tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
english: Of the children of Joseph, of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Ephraim nama, a simte uh sing li leh za nga ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

paite: Manase tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
english: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Manase nama, a simte uh, sing thum leh sang nih leh za nih ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

paite: Benjamin tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
english: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Benjamin nama, a simte uh, sing thum leh sang nga leh za li ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

paite: Dan tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
english: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go forth to war;

paite: Dan nama, a simte uh, sing guk leh sang nih leh za sagih ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

paite: Aser tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
english: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go forth to war;

paite: Aser nama, a simte uh, sing li leh sang khat leh za nga ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

paite: Naphtali tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
english: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go forth to war;

paite: Naphtali nama, a simte uh, sing nga leh sang thum leh za li ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

paite: Huaite ahi uh, Mosi leh Aronin Israel lupen sawm leh nih, inkuana lupente toh a simte.
english: These are those who were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: they were each one for his fathers’ house.

paite: Huchiin Israel suan a inkuankuan ua kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei chiang teng, Israel gamate sim ahi uh;
english: So all those who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel;

paite: A simte teng uh nuai guk leh sang thum leh za nga leh sawmnga ahi uh.
english: even all those who were numbered were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

paite: Levite pipute jaw a simtel kei uh.
english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

paite: TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
english: For Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Levi chi jaw na simtel ding ahi keia, Israel mite lakah na simtel ding ahi sam kei:
english: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not number, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

paite: Levite jaw theihsakna biakbuk kemmite leh van tengteng kemmite dia seh jawk ding ahi: biakbuka van tengteng a zong jel ding ua, a kem ding ua, tua biakbuk a kimvelin a omkhum ding uh.
english: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle, and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

paite: Huan, biakbuk malama a pai chiangin Leviten a phel ding ua; huan, biakbuk kaih ding chiangin Levite mahin a kai nawn ding uh; nam dang a hongkigolh peuhmah hihlup ding ahi.
english: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

paite: Huan, Israel suanten amau mun chiat ah, a pawlpawlin a tamdan uh dungjui jelin a puaninte uh a kai ding uh.
english: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

paite: Leviten Israel suante khawmpi tunga hehna a omlouhna dingin theihsakna biakbuk kimvelah a akai ding uhi; Leviten theihsakna biakbuk a kep ding uh ahi, chia thu a nagentak jiakin,Huchibangin Israel suanten ahih uh; TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak tengteng bangin, huchibangin a hih uh.
english: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

paite: Huchibangin Israel suanten ahih uh; TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak tengteng bangin, huchibangin a hih uh.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they did.
